en_quote: Strong risk assessment, CDD processes, transaction monitoring, suspicious activity reporting, and adequate resource allocation are critical.
knowledge_zh: 关键要素：风险评估、客户尽职调查、交易监控、可疑报告和资源分配

en_quote: Consequences of risk management deficiencies can include significant penalties, mandatory program improvements, enhanced regulatory oversight, and reputational damage.
knowledge_zh: 风险管理缺陷后果包括重大罚款、项目整改、监管加强和声誉损失
